title: 黄仁勋的“光”：详解AI算力背后的光通信产业链、英伟达赌注与技术博弈
content: Jensen Huang is aggressively investing in optical communications to solve the "communication wall" bottleneck in AI data centers, where GPU speeds outpace copper interconnect capabilities. The industry is shifting toward silicon photonics and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) to reduce power consumption and latency. Key players like Marvell and Lumentum face consolidation and capacity challenges, while Chinese manufacturers dominate module assembly. Despite recent market volatility caused by Huang’s temporary resignation and CPO timeline uncertainties, optical infrastructure remains essential for scaling AI workloads.

title: 黎曼猜想之后，代数版P≠NP证明了
content: On November 24, Anthropic and OpenAI independently proved VP≠VNP, the algebraic analog of P≠NP, using AI-generated formal Lean proofs. Anthropic’s submission contained 73,000 lines of code; OpenAI’s contained 440,000. Both results established super-polynomial lower bounds for the permanent, a problem unsolved for decades. While formal verification confirmed internal logical consistency, the results remain subject to human peer review. This breakthrough signifies AI’s capability to solve complex mathematical conjectures, though the original P≠NP question remains unresolved.

title: 我想赶在 AI 替代我之前，先替代我自己
content: A binary vulnerability researcher developed Treasure Map, an MCP tool that organizes firmware data into a read-only fact layer and an AI-annotated layer. Unlike linear models, it provides multiple analytical views, allowing agents to filter candidates and verify results dynamically. Incorporating firmware patch comparison, the tool identifies vulnerable code and attack surface expansions. This system enhances audit efficiency and accuracy, proving that structured data integration improves AI-assisted security analysis beyond simple model replacement.
